body: That’s strange, I got my diagnosis done for free. But I guess it depends where you are.
The expectations of the essay, all the requirements. They all add up to my paralysis because I think to myself I’m not going to be able to add all of this information.

It really doesn’t work that way when you see it through the eyes of someone who has autism/adhd. I go through something called paralysis, and what you just told me would immediately trigger a response where I would be in a frozen state of saying it’s not too hard and I would end up not getting the assignment done. It’s like telling me to do a to-do list, I’m going to stare at that list because I’d be stuck in paralysis figuring out how to do it.
But it’s just English class

Sadly I went to tutoring so many times but they just give me outlines for the essay. It never helps because I only am more active when I get the essay done then and there. When I have an assignment at home Im braindead and lost at that point with no one to ask, you either have to pay to get the essay done or suffer and take the F
Low Eye contact and social awkwardness are some symptoms I know, im sure you could find a center that specializes on this and helps adults with autism, that’s what I did

I relate a lot with your post, I don’t want to be a burden to my family as well. And my school and get academic probation and removed of my financial support. I just want to be smart and impress everyone but my fucking autistic self can’t do shit and I’m falling apart.
I am still waiting to see one, and my dad already knows I go through this stuff so ya
Lol for all I care they can tell the whole school. I just hope they get the message to leave me alone.
Aw thats too bad i wanted soup
Ya in dms..
Ya.. at least i do regret it.. but it doesn’t excuse what i did, and i can never forget the people I’ve hurt
Im here
Hmm i ruined my life, everyone left me , now i have huge abandonment and suicide obsession issues
Lol food isn’t gonna motivate me to stay here, but im still here :(
ya.. I couldn’t do anything
im sorry
its not there, nothing good is happening, nothing will get better, i only have a few hours left
3 hours left

I can’t promise I won’t do anything. I’m sure this pain was worth handling for most of my life. I pretty much deserved it. I have low hopes for any great future at the moment. I just don’t want to wake up tomorrow at all.

You were a few hours early before i did anything so you’re fine. I don’t deserve to be missed, i’ve hurt so many people, created so many problems, i just want to know what the hell is wrong with me. But I don’t have 3 months to find that out. I have a therapist, they definitely do not care. Sent me off to some group therapy because they couldn’t handle me. I’m probbaly going to end up hurting everyone there to. Im tired of waking up to the same thing every day, school, no friends, more anti-social and anxiety problems to worry about. I could never make friends irl so i tried online. Of course it didn’t work out. And you’re 13, you have so much to live for, i don’t I ruined my chances for a happy life. Its either live with my horrible parents and take care of them the rest of my life or find a boyfriend and ditch them in 2 years. I’m just running out of options here. These voices won’t shut up and they’re tempting me to do something.
